updates: Automatic board generator now creates a utility-to-MDB-SMDB-DB single-line diagram.
Saudi LV reference shown as 230/400 V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60 Hz.
SLD can be downloaded as SVG and printed/exported to PDF.
Design basis notes reference SBC 401 and the Saudi Arabian Distribution Code; project-specific SEC requirements remain subject to engineer verification.
Smart Project Schedule now opens in a true viewport-wide/full-height focus mode.
Workspace sidebar, header, footer and collapse toggle are hidden while Smart Schedule is open so no workspace controls cover the tool.
Smart Schedule modal uses 100vw × 100vh with zero outer padding and a full-size iframe.
Project Schedule now opens in the same true viewport-wide/full-height tool focus mode as Smart Schedule.
Project Schedule hides the Workspace sidebar, header, footer and collapse toggle while active.
Site Forms & Document Control now opens in true 100vw × 100vh fullscreen tool mode with no outer Workspace padding or overlay margin.
Site Forms hides the Workspace sidebar, header, footer and collapse toggle while active.
All three dedicated tools return cleanly to the Workspace when closed.

Smart Schedule replaced with EngineX Scheduler P6: full CPM engine (forward/backward pass, total/free float, critical path), FS/SS/FF/SF relationships with lag/lead, working-day calendars with KSA holidays, constraints (SNET/SNLT/FNET/FNLT/MSO/MFO/ALAP), baselines with variance, EVM (PV/EV/AC/SPI/CPI/EAC), resource histograms, DCMA 14-point schedule quality check, and CSV/JSON import-export. Same launcher slot and file name, so no other workspace changes were needed.

Users & Access is now Administrator-only: non-administrator accounts do not see the Users & Access tab, and create/delete user actions are also blocked by an in-app role check. The administrator can provision usernames, passwords, and roles while regular engineers retain normal workspace access.
GitHub import: introduction videos optimized to 720p H.264/AAC for web delivery; file checksums refreshed.
notes: Added functional Users & Access account provisioning, username/password login validation, password update persistence, reliable Home Portal sign-out return, and Administrator-only user management access.
